scene: The brass crane swallows your copper token and coughs up a glowing key.
picture: Side-scrolling view on flat cobblestones. On the far left, the towering brass crane bends low, mouth open with a dangling green key. Centre-left, the Pacific Islander girl in sky-blue windbreaker reaches forward with her sketchbook tucked under her arm. Far right, an open cogway tunnel glows with spinning gears.
shown: A bright neon-green key dangling from the crane's open beak on the far left
A blank page in the player's sketchbook held underarm at centre-left
A dark brick archway glowing with spinning gears on the far right
